'''Xu Ningsheng''' ({{lang-zh|s=许宁生|t=|p=|labels=no}}; born 7 July 1957) is a Chinese physicist and academic administrator. He previously served as [[President of Fudan University|president of]] [[Fudan University]] from 2014 to 2021, president of [[Sun Yat-sen University]] from 2010 to 2014, vice president of Sun Yat-sen University from 2004 to 2010, and dean of the Sun Yat-sen University School of Physical Science and Engineering Technology from 1999 to 2004.

He is an academician of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] and [[The World Academy of Sciences]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://www.fudan.edu.cn/entries/view/2519/|title=Xu Ningsheng|date=2018-10-15|website=Fudan University|access-date=2019-02-07}}</ref>

==Biography==
Xu was born in Zhanlong Town of [[Puning]], [[Guangdong]] province, on July 7, 1957, with his [[Ancestral home (Chinese)|ancestral home]] in [[Chenghai District]], [[Shantou]]. Xu secondary studied at Xingwen High School.

He was a [[sent-down youth]] from 1975 to 1978, during the [[Cultural Revolution]].

After the Resumption of University Entrance Examination in 1977, he studied, then taught, at the Department of Physics of [[Sun Yat-sen University]], in [[Guangzhou]]. He received his doctor's degree from [[Aston University]] in 1986, and taught at the university for 10 years afterwards.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.163.com/14/1031/18/A9TI58CQ00014SEH.html |script-title=zh:复旦新任校长许宁生“首秀”：纯正英语让英国勋爵“点赞” |newspaper=163.com |date=2014-10-31 |language= zh}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.sina.com.cn/o/2014-10-25/142931044242.shtml |script-title=zh:许宁生，结缘中大36年 |newspaper=Sina |date= 2014-10-25|language=zh }}</ref>

He was honored as a Distinguished Young Scholar by the National Science Fund for Distinguished Young Scholars ({{lang|zh|国家杰出青年科学基金}}) in 1995.

In 1996 and that year, he returned to China and became professor of physics at Sun Yat-sen University, becoming Dean of its School of Physics and Engineering in 1999, and was promoted to vice-president in 2004. He also served as Dean of International Exchange College between 2004 and 2008.

He was elected a fellow of the [[Institute of Physics]] in 1998. He was named a [[Chang Jiang Scholar]] by the [[Ministry of Education of the People's Republic of China|Ministry of Education of China]] in 1999.

In December 2010, he was appointed President of Sun Yat-sen University.<ref>{{cite news|url=http://news.163.com/15/0127/11/AGVBPN4Q00014SEH.html |script-title=zh:罗俊接棒许宁生，成为改革开放后中山大学第7任掌校人 |newspaper=163.com |date= 2015-01-27|language= zh}}</ref> In October 2014 he was appointed [[President of Fudan University]].<ref name=":0" />
